name: io.github.duowaveai/speak-when-done
title: Speak When Done
description: Voice notifications for AI coding agents: text to speech MCP server that says when the agent is done

environmentVariables.name: SPEAK_LANGUAGE
environmentVariables.description: Language of the phrases as a BCP 47 tag, e.g. en-US, de, ru. Picks a matching system voice.

environmentVariables.name: SPEAK_VOICE
environmentVariables.description: System voice name, e.g. Samantha on macOS. Default: the system voice.

environmentVariables.name: DUOWAVE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Address of DuoWave (https://duowave.ai) to speak on a speaker in the room, e.g. http://localhost:7780.

environmentVariables.name: DUOWAVE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. A DuoWave access key (Settings, People and access, Access keys).

environmentVariables.name: DUOWAVE_TARGET
environmentVariables.description: Where DuoWave speaks: auto (default), speaker or computer.
